**I’d choose the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W solar-panel kit** for a hurricane outage. Its 2,073.6 Wh battery is a stronger fit for keeping essentials such as a fridge and CPAP going through a day and night than a small camping-size station. The listing shows it at **$1,199**: [check the kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).

One caveat: **200 W of solar is limited when skies are overcast**—the panel may contribute little during stormy weather. Charge the station fully before the storm, and treat solar as a way to extend runtime afterward, not as guaranteed backup power. If you want a lower-cost option, the same listing shows a [BLUETTI AC180 + 200 W kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit) at $729. Prices can change.
